import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt

command=['gh','run','list','-L','3','--json','conclusion,status,databaseId,headSha,url']
runs=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(command,text=True))
head=runs[0]['headSha']; checks_cmd=['gh','api',f'repos/ncoprod/makemarketbench/commits/{head}/check-runs']
checks=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(checks_cmd,text=True))
records=[]
for check in checks['check_runs']:
 cmd=['gh','api',f"repos/ncoprod/makemarketbench/check-runs/{check['id']}/annotations"]
 annotations=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(cmd,text=True))
 records.append({'name':check['name'],'conclusion':check['conclusion'],'url':check['html_url'],
  'annotations_command':cmd,'annotations':[{k:a[k] for k in ('annotation_level','message')} for a in annotations]})
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'Verify current hosted CI refusal after November 1'}),
 'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'commands':[command,checks_cmd],'runs':runs,'checked_commit':head,
 'checks':records,'status':'passed' if records and all(c['conclusion']=='success' for c in records) else 'failed',
 'scope':'Actual hosted Linux Python3.10/3.12 matrix and ASan/UBSan statuses; prior billing refusals retained separately. Local fallback is recorded separately.'}
Path('results/ci_hosted_final.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print([(r['name'],r['conclusion']) for r in records])
